answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 20277 Country: India Title: I need guidence regarding a person whom i had visited for cure of jinn,black magic etc who treats all sorts of black magic, jins etc & he is a well known Alim,how do i identify if he is doing according to shariah or not or if it is any sort of shirk? Question: Assalamu aalaikum wr wb I need guidence regarding a person whom i had visited for cure of jinn,black magic etc who treats all sorts of black magic, jins etc & he is a well known Alim,how do i identify if he is doing according to shariah or not or if it is any sort of shirk plz guide me Answer ID: 20277 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 282/B=45/tb=1431) Go there and examine his system of healing, or ask those who have experienced his treatment. If he does according to Islam, opt for his treatment, and if he does against Islamic teaching, avoid it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
